p: Lemuel: That is, of Solomon who was called Lemuel, that is, of God, because God had ordained him to be king over Israel.
prophecy that his mother taught him: The doctrine which his mother Bathsheba taught him.
my womb: By this often repetition of one thing, she declares her motherly affection.
nor thy ways to that which: Meaning, that women are the destruction of kings, if they hunt them.
strong drink: That is, the king must not give himself to wantonness, and neglect of his office, which is to execute judgment.
his poverty: For wine comforts the heart as in Ps 104:15.
dumb in the cause of all: Defend their cause that are not able to help themselves.
spoil: He will not need to use any unlawful means to gain his living.
portion to her maidens: She prepares their food early.
buyeth it: She purchases it with the gains of her travail.
gates: In the assemblies and places of judgment.
Strength and honour are her clothing: After he had spoken of the apparel of the body, he now declares the apparel of the spirit.
law of kindness: Her tongue is a book by which one might learn many good things: for she delights to talk of the word of God.
call her blessed: That is, do her reverence.
her of the fruit of her: Confess her diligent labours, and commend her therefore.
gates: Forasmuch as the most honourable are clad in the apparel that she made.
